description: One decision. The stand-in answers first; it decides alone only where its autonomy for this decision class is earned, otherwise the person decides on a card with its recommendation. Each input of standInMayDecide has one supplier, and none of them is the stand-in's caller: tier is the item's, set by triage (TRIAGED), never by the request; expectationsMet is the item's, from its acceptGate, for an accept decision; autonomy is the ladder's rung for the class over the store's own decided decisions (its logPrecedent effects and answered audits dated at or before the spawn; no log file kept by hand), which the harness reads when it spawns the decision (recommend if they cannot be read, so the person decides); threshold is the constant in this machine's context; confidence is the stand-in's, the only number its answer carries. Only a person's tap decides for the person: the machine checks that PERSON_DECIDED says actor person and source tap with the card's message id; that the tap is real is checked afterwards against the platform.

STAND_IN_ANSWERED.description: Refused unless a session sends it: the stand-in is a session.

Refused from the orchestrator and from every worker that reported a run for this item (both recorded on the decision when it is spawned): only the stand-in answers, never the party whose work it judges or the one that routes it. The machine compares the ids it is given; who the sessions are is checked afterwards.

Refused unless the answer is exactly a choice, a confidence between 0 and 1, and optionally a reason. An answer that carries autonomy or threshold is refused: the machine holds both. A missing confidence is refused; there is no default.

routing.description: The stand-in decides alone when the tier is below 2, the class's autonomy (set at spawn from the ladder) is act, its confidence is at or above the machine's threshold, and, for an accept decision, the item's expectationsMet was true when the decision opened (false or unknown is not); otherwise the person decides.

awaitingPerson.description: A decision card is in front of the person, with the stand-in's recommendation.

PERSON_DECIDED.description: Refused unless the actor is a person and the source a tap whose ref is the decision card's message id. The machine checks the kinds and that the id is there; whether the tap happened is checked afterwards against the platform.
